title: Detection of exogenous DNA uptake by murine dendritic cells
protocol: Harvest 2 mouse spleens in RPMI and keep on ice.
Inject 50 μL of digestion buffer (1 mg/mL Collagenase A and 50 U/mL DNase I in RPMI) into each side of the spleen and incubate for 1 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Mince the spleens and digest with 10 mL of digestion buffer for 30 min at 32°C–35°C with gentle stirring using a magnet.
Add EDTA for a final concentration of 1 mM during the last 5 min of digestion to minimize cell clumping.
Filter through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Spin down cells at 300 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Wash the cell strainer with 5 mL of HBSS in the 50 mL tube before filtering the cells to reduce the impact of cells landing in the bottom of the tube.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL FACS buffer.
Count cells and adjust to 1 × 10^8 cells/mL in FACS buffer.
Add TruStain FcX™ PLUS at a 1:2000 dilution and incubate for 10 minutes on ice.
Prepare a mixture of biotin conjugated antibodies (10 μL Ly6C, 20 μL Ter119, 20 μL CD49b, 30 μL Ly6G, 40 μL CD3e and B220 in 1000 μL total volume of FACS buffer).
Spin down cells at 300 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Add the biotin antibody mixture to splenocytes and mix well.
Incubate the mixture for 20 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge the mixture at 300 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Wash once with 2 mL cold FACS buffer.
Vortex the MojoSort Nanoparticles.
Prepare a working dilution by adding 7.5 μL–992.5 μL of FACS buffer as needed to match the cell concentration from step 5.
Add pre-mixed MojoSort beads to splenocytes and mix well.
Incubate for 10 minutes on ice.
Add FACS buffer to reach a total volume of 3 mL.
Transfer cells to a 5 mL polystyrene tube and place in a magnet designed to hold the tube for 3 minutes.
Decant supernatant containing dendritic cells.
Count cells and resuspend at 10^6/mL in RPMI supplemented with 1% fetal bovine serum.
Quickly thaw frozen EdU-labeled tumor debris at 37°C.
Add β-mercaptoethanol to thawed EdU-labeled tumor debris to achieve a final concentration of 55 μM.
Plate DCs from step 13 in a 96-well round-bottom plate, using between 1 × 10^5 to 2 × 10^5 cells per well.
Spin down the plated DCs at 300 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant from spun-down DCs and resuspend in 100 μL of EdU-labeled tumor debris.
Culture cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for up to 2 hours before proceeding to the next step.
Incubate cells for 4–6 hours to evaluate DC activation, if necessary.
Add monensin and brefeldin A during the last 4 hours of culture for intracellular cytokine detection.
Supplement tumor cell debris with 1% FBS for incubation times longer than 2 hours to improve cell viability.
Spin down plate at 300 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Wash once with 200 μL cold FACS buffer.
Create a mixture of Live/Dead Zombie NIR dye (1:1000 dilution) and TruStain FcX (1:2000 dilution) in PBS (no protein).
Add 200 μL of the mixture to the cells.
Incubate for 30 min on ice protected from light.
Prepare the surface antibody mixture (200 μL per sample) in cold FACS buffer during the incubation period.
Spin down at 300 g for 10 min.
Wash with 200 μL ice cold FACS buffer.
Add 200 μL of antibody mixture to cells.
Resuspend gently by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 30 min on ice protected from light.
Spin down at 300 g for 10 min.
Wash with 200 μL ice cold FACS buffer.
Resuspend the pellet gently in 100 μL BD Cytofix Fixation Buffer.
Incubate for 15 minutes on ice protected from light.
Spin down at 500 g for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Store cells in FACS buffer or proceed to Click-iT EdU reaction.
Harvest BMDCs and distribute 10^6 per well of a 96-well plate.
Spin down plate at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash once with 200 μL cold FACS buffer.
Fix cells for 10–15 minutes at room temperature using 200 μL BD Cytofix or 4% paraformaldehyde in 1× PBS.
Permeabilize and block cells for 10 minutes at room temperature using 200 μL of perm/block buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 2% BSA, in 1× PBS).
Spin down plate at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash once with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Incubate with 200 μL of a solution of anti-mouse GAPDH in FACS buffer (1:200) for 1 h at room temperature.
Spin down plate at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash twice with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Incubate with 200 μL of AF488 anti-rabbit secondary antibody in FACS buffer (1:200) for 1 h at room temperature.
Spin down plate at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash twice with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Incubate with 200 μL of Hoechst 33342 in FACS buffer (1:1000) for 10 min.
Spin down plate at 300 g for 10 min at room temperature and remove the supernatant.
Add 40 μL Click-iT-Saponin based permeabilization buffer and resuspend the DCs.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature protected from light.
Prepare 1× Click-iT EdU reaction buffer additive by diluting the 10× stock solution in deionized water.
Add PBS or DPBS, 175 μL per sample/well.
Pipette copper protectant, 4 μL per sample/well.
Pipette fluorescent dye, 1 μL per sample/well.
Mix reaction buffer additive (1×), 20 μL per sample/well.
Add 200 μl Click-iT Plus reaction cocktail directly onto the 40 μL Click-iT-Saponin and gently pipette up and down 2–3 times for mixing.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature, protected from light.
Spin down plate at 500 g for 5 min.
Wash with 1× Click-iT-Saponin based permeabilization buffer.
Repeat washing step with Click-iT-Saponin based permeabilization buffer.
Resuspend in FACS buffer.
Analyze by flow cytometry or image cytometry.
Immobilize cells on glass slides by cytospin centrifugation at 1000 g for 10 minutes for immunofluorescent microscopy.
Store immobilized cells under coverslips using Prolong Gold Mountant up to 7 days at 4°C.
